description: Source code for the RootCanvas SwiftUI view, managing app UI, onboarding flow, gateway connection status, and related interactions in an iOS app.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View handling the app's root interface, onboarding, settings, and status display.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data model representing the payload for the home canvas display, including gateway status and agent info.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Data model for individual agent representation on the home canvas.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Subview displaying the main content area with status, toolbar, and overlays.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: View presenting a flash overlay animation for camera actions.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines initial presentation route based on connection and onboarding state.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides whether to present the quick setup sheet based on current app states.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the device's idle timer depending on app state.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates debug status overlay on the app's screen if enabled.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Generates and sends the current home canvas payload to update UI state.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload object for the home canvas based on app and gateway status.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Resolves the currently active agent's ID based on app model and selection.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from app model.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Generates list of agent cards for display, marking active and default agents.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns normalized name for an agent.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Returns badge string for an agent, using emoji or initials.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Trims whitespace; returns nil if the string is empty after trimming.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to present onboarding or settings on app launch.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing gateway configuration.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Auto-opens settings sheet based on current state and onboarding status.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Shows quick setup sheet if conditions are met.
